description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarModule class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests the constructor, moduleImplements method, and loadBean method, including handling of invalid inputs and expected behaviors.

classes.name: SugarModuleTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing features of the SugarModule class related to module handling and instantiation.

methods.name: testconstructor
methods.description: Tests the constructor behavior of SugarModule, including handling of empty module names and valid module names.

methods.name: testmoduleImplements
methods.description: Tests whether the moduleImplements method correctly identifies module capabilities.

methods.name: testloadBean
methods.description: Tests the loadBean method for proper object instantiation and handling of invalid module names.
